summary.headline: Astrological Rules for Rain
summary.text: Astrological rules for predicting rain from Venus, Mercury, the Moon, malefics, lunar nodes, and their positions in rainy signs, including aspects, conjunctions, retrogradation, and solar ingress into Capricorn.
